title: Quantizing Deep Convolutional Networks for Efficient Inference: A Whitepaper
annotation: The foundational industrial whitepaper formulating uniform affine quantization, scale and zero-point parameterization, and Quantization-Aware Training with Straight-Through Estimators.

title: Roofline: An Insightful Visual Performance Model for Multicore Architectures
authors: Samuel Williams, Andrew Waterman, David Patterson
publisher: Communications of the ACM, Vol. 52, No. 4, pp. 65-76
annotation: The seminal paper establishing the Roofline visual performance model, linking operational arithmetic intensity to hardware compute ceilings and memory bandwidth boundaries.

title: Pruning Filters for Efficient ConvNets
authors: Hao Li, Asim Kadav, Igor Durdanovic, Hanan Samet, Hans Peter Graf
annotation: Pioneers structured filter pruning in deep convolutional networks using L1-norm magnitude metrics, proving that dense matrix reduction achieves real latency speedups on generic hardware.

title: MobileNets: Efficient Convolutional Neural Networks for Mobile Vision Applications
authors: Andrew G. Howard, Menglong Zhu, Bo Chen, Dmitry Kalenichenko, Weijun Wang, Tobias Weyand, Marco Andreetto, Hartwig Adam
annotation: Introduces depthwise separable convolutions for edge vision, drastically reducing compute parameters while highlighting memory bandwidth trade-offs on mobile and embedded chipsets.
